text:
maya: Quick sync for Marketplace launch ops — need to lock badge distro, SI standby rota, regional listing cadence, and press playbook. Who can take quick owners?
diego: I can take badge distro + CDN schedule. Will push assets to /assets/marketplace/badges-v4 by Tue noon.
rachel: PR + spokes here. Ill own media kit and helpline rota for T+0..T+3h. Need legal-safe bites from tom.
tom: Legal ok to review. Reminder: avoid words like "guaranteed uptime" and include localized privacy links for EU/JP listings. Need final landing copy by Mon COB.
ops-bot: FYI staging tokens expire 2026-03-24T23:59Z; request rotate if you need extended dry-runs.
partner-aws: AWS SI asks for 30m stagger between NA/EU/APAC flips. Can we support that?
diego: Yes, we can feature-flag with ff.market.na|eu|apac and queue CDN purges at -10m per region.
rachel: Press plan preference is single global embargo end-time to reduce leak risk. If regions flip early, partners should keep PR dark until embargo lift. Will draft guidance.
tom: Ill produce a short embargo addendum for partner agreements and a checklist for trademark approvals.
maya: Action items: diego -> badges + CDN; rachel -> media kit + helpline; tom -> legal addendum + copy review; ops-bot -> ensure token window; partner-aws -> confirm legal contact. Dry-run Wed 10:00 PT. If no blockers by Tue EOD, we aim for Fri flip. :white_check_mark:
